Sitting here quietly I thought about the unfamiliar ceiling. I wonder how many people have been here? What have they thought about as they looked at it? In the silence, these thoughts and questions buzzed about the room without reverberation.

As I listened to the children, plans for the future seemed out of reach. Too many things would have to change and nothing ever does. Yes, the world is round but only the rarest of souls ever make it all the way around. For the rest of us, even the simplest pleasures are hard to come by.
Waiting for the bell to ring, I took a deep breath of air tinged with the children’s voices. The bell’s clear, sharp notes pierced the silence I had grown used to. Someone would be coming soon. I sat back and waited.
